Walking in on day one to a wall of expectations can land as a signal that the bar is high and they are already behind, which triggers avoidance or people-pleasing instead of genuine engagement. Whatever you are feeling right now is a completely normal response to a brain that is taking in a huge amount of new information at once."}, {"phase": "Curiosity", "words": "I want to ask you one thing before I share my end: what would make this first stretch feel like it was actually working for you? situation: A new hire starts Monday and I want to set clear expectations without overwhelming them.
